title: Bounded Exec
description: Run one shell command under an absolute ceiling and a no-progress bound, with process-tree cleanup.

cwd.description: Working directory. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace root.

env.description: Environment variables made available to the command.

timeoutMs.description: Absolute wall-clock ceiling in milliseconds. A backstop against an unbounded run, not a performance budget.

idleTimeoutMs.description: Kill the process tree after this many milliseconds with no stdout or stderr. Detects a wedged process independently of machine speed and load. Omit for no progress bound.

killAfterMs.description: Milliseconds to wait after graceful termination before force-killing the process tree.

forwardAllArgs.description: Append unparsed Nx CLI arguments to the command.

args.description: Extra arguments appended to the command.
